content.text:
The ribbon now matches the spec. The only thing that was different was the group titles: they used to sit centred under each group, and now they run bottom to top along the group's left edge. Each title sits on a thin strip with a slightly lighter background than the ribbon.

Everything else in the spec was already built: the tabs and their order, the commands and their tooltips, disabled states, the fixed height, and collapsing.

- **How:** gpui can only rotate SVG images, not text. So each title is drawn as a small SVG containing the text, turned -90°. The code is in `group` and `group_title` in `src/ribbon.rs`.
- **Font fix:** the first attempt drew "Build" in the wrong font, with letters that looked Greek. The SVG renderer doesn't recognise the theme's system font name, so titles now use the default sans-serif font.
- **Checked in the running app:** I zoomed in on screenshots. "Build" and "Appearance" read bottom to top in a sans-serif font, centred on their strips. I didn't look at "Project" or "Preferences". One oddity: both screenshots showed a tab other than Project selected, although the code opens on Project. That may have been my mouse rather than the app, but I didn't look into it.
